It is the SAME man as in the reference (green and white trucker cap, black sunglasses, beige t-shirt with the green mountain print, red plaid shirt tied round the waist, denim shorts, hiking boots, an old black film camera on a strap) with real human proportions, full body, front view, feet at the bottom edge. He is a dead man who still walks: waxy grey-green skin with dark purple blotches, like a hanged man. His neck is stretched far too long and thin, twisted and bruised black, the camera strap biting deep into it. His head has dropped sideways and hangs upside-down against his shoulder, the face slack and grey, the mouth hanging open in a long dark silent scream, the sunglasses cracked, the cap still on. Dark dried stains down the front of the t-shirt and on his hands. And still he holds the camera up straight at the viewer with both hands at chest height, the flash lit, steady, as if nothing is wrong.
